correctness.rationale: At rho=1/10 the three full-rank source cone matrices have q=(1,1) interior, all A_rho send w=(1,1) strictly positive, and tau=1/5 dilation excludes f(0)-f(t) from the domination cone for all t!=0. Thus f(0) is Ch-quasi-proper non-dominated under the printed conditions, with affine f and strictly feasible g=-1. At t>0 both original row scalarizations of f(s)=(s,-s) are s; both subgradients are {1}, h derivative zero, all constraints inactive, so Theorem 4.1(a) requires 0=lambda1+lambda2 with positive multipliers, contradiction. xi=(1/2,1/2) has negative coefficient -1/2 in pointwise A_rho row basis; polar of common intersection cannot imply all pointwise polar memberships. Exact rational independent matrix checks confirm all sign inequalities.
